rationale: B wins because it has the discipline to kill the shiny-but-unsourced money story and put the sharpest factual tension in the center: "Whoop's new blood-pressure number isn't a medical reading — and needs a cuff to even start." A has useful material, but "Whoop's clinical features are also a pitch to its next investors" is a funding thesis wearing a launch hat. B's refused line — "At a $3.6B valuation, Whoop bets big on medical features to justify its price" — correctly spots the trap A walked into.
gaps_in_A: "Whoop's clinical features are also a pitch to its next investors" invents a financing narrative. The update gives valuation history, not a fundraise, exit process, investor pressure, or company strategy.

"ahead of a future round or exit" is speculative padding. A admits it needs "confirmation of any current fundraising activity," which means the angle should be held or reframed, not pitched as a live story.
"blood-pressure feature was designed to avoid that step" overclaims intent. The facts say non-medical wellness estimate, not diagnostic; they do not say Whoop designed it to dodge FDA review.

"health-equity reporter" may be too lofty without the actual tier price, affected user group, or access impact. The paywall angle is real, but it needs numbers before it becomes more than a subscription gripe.
gaps_in_B: "screenless band" is not in the supplied update. It may be true in the real world, but this judge only has the prompt; source it or cut it.
"Apple Watch / Samsung / Fitbit feature race" names a competitive frame the update did not supply. The fact says competitors already ship FDA-cleared ECG, not which ones.
"the wearable was supposed to replace" overstates the blood-pressure premise. The supplied facts say the feature requires cuff calibration; they do not say Whoop promised cuff replacement.

B misses a clean regulatory angle: FDA-cleared ECG beside explicitly non-medical blood-pressure insights, with cardiologist advisory-board review. That is a real digital-health policy story left on the table.
